summary.name: DiffMerge
summary.one_liner: DiffMerge is a visual file comparison and merge application for Windows, OS X and Linux.
use_cases: compare two versions of a file
compare two folders side by side
summary.what_it_does: DiffMerge graphically shows differences between two files, with intra-line highlighting and full editing support. It also shows changes across three files and allows automatic merging when it is judged safe, with control over the resulting file. It compares two folders side by side, marking files present in only one side and pairs that are identical or different. On Windows it adds a right-click option in Windows Explorer to diff any two files. Rulesets and options allow customizing appearance and behavior.
notable: Three-way file comparison with automatic merging when safe
Folder comparison showing files present in only one side or differing pairs
Identical feature set across Windows, OS X and Linux
caveats: Pricing is inferred from the 'Freeware' label in the listing, not stated on the page text
